chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu duukam kiicham jix bhai'x jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam aapi' oidha' gɨ' gu kutun bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' suakɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham juraa'n gu takarui' bɨx dha'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Judaa kuiñcha gu jodai' gu duukam juantu'n; gio ba' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu duukam jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.

Na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Sioon namki' gu chuukug na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx kiki'ñgob gu chuukug jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr a'aalh jix bɨɨx duu gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ka't mar u'vɨ gu Sioon bɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' chiñia' jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p gu ñi'ook cham bakia' gu takarui' jix duñia' cham gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' cham ka't u'ua'tɨdham tɨ'ñcho gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' uañi'ñ jugi gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu ux tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na gu' jix duñia' xi'ɨraam; jano' ba' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' cham tɨ'ñcho gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x cham juraa'n nuukdaidha'; na gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na gu' bhaamki'ñdha' tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' bɨx tu'x a'bhar; gio ba' tu' buupui baakɨi xidhuu chɨbɨɨp jix aa'ñdhix cham ba'k gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu jiim; gio ba' jix maa gu ux jugi bɨx tu'x a'bhar na ba' kapbhai' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu jodai' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨbiap; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Jano' ba' dɨr jix bhai'x bhañ gu tai o'oo jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix vɨgɨ tɨɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' jix dhaas gu takarui' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' dhagia' gu Jawatan gu noobh bhaan cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan tu' gu suudai' bɨx jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jup tɨɨt bhaan tu' chu'p na ba' jix duñia' biipibop; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha tu' suanda'; gio ba' gu vupui gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' tu' nuukdaidha' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu suudai' na gu' bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Sioon jix duñia' gu noobh cham juraa'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jakob gu ñi'ook mia'n; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai'; na tu' bhaan gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu jodai' biipibop jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jiiñak dha' gu' jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan daraa kiicham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jugi na ba' bɨɨx kapbhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu o'o; gio ba' ba'k gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x; jano' ba' mai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook koi'm.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch nuukdaidha' na ba' tu'; gio ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' naak cham bhai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duu jix ai gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vupui bɨɨx na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' mui'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan i'iich mar u'vɨ gu Sioon jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu jodai' gu Israeel cham tɨ'ñcho dhaibu' tɨɨt gu tanoolh daak.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan cham jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' i'iich bɨx vaak zel gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ gu ux gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt mar u'vɨ gu Judaa jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chiñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx i'iich gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu suudai' kɨɨ'n vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu Jakob na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tai tu' gu chuukug gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia' gu novɨ tu jiim na ja'p gu tasi' mu'aa bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' ñiata; gio ba' vaak zel mar u'vɨ gu Sioon ja'aa na ja'p gu tai gu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan na ja'p bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix mui' mar u'vɨ gu Judaa ɨlhdha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak zel na ja'p u'uu pai' jix duñia' pai' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Sioon gu ñi'ook tas na jix bhaan tu' jix bhai'x i'iich daak gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' xidhuu tu' dhagia' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu tanoolh gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham tu' duu gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu duukam cham gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ cham tu' duu; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu takarui' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' bɨɨma'n.

Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob jix bɨɨx duu mi'x juu'ñ gu ux gu oidha' jix duñia' gu vupui; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa gu oidha' jix duñia' daraa mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu chuukug gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu Jerusalem tɨsaa'ñdhak ɨɨbhidham gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu vupui jix duñia' suakɨt jix duñia' ba'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'aa gu ux gu oidha' gu ux gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu jodai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt kiicham.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji naana'n; gio ba' duukat tiriik suudai' u'va gu suudai' na ja'p gu chuukug gu vaak kiicham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jix suudai' duu naana'n.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ookdham tu' gu jodai' chɨkka tu' gu bhóogɨt nɨidhim mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem chɨkka tu' ua'rgidhai na ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon na gu' jix gɨ' gu jodai' na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham jix duñia' uañi'ñ na ba' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' nɨnɨi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu noobh bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' ɨɨbhidham bhaan mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem bham; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug kiicham am:―Ja'pji gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu chin jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu jodai'; jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu ux gu tanoolh gu suudai'; gio ba' gu jodai' gaagam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu tanoolh tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't jix aa'ñdhix dɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia' cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan tu' bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon mi'x juu'ñ suakɨt na ja'p gu jodai' gu tanoolh gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu vupui.

Jano' ba' bamii' jix maa jiiñak gu tukaa' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix duñia'; gio ba' biiñ na ja'p gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu ux gu oidha' pu'ñix gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhiogi' ba'k bɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook chɨkka gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu u'vɨ gu i'bhɨ pu'ñix gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai' koko'kam xidhuu gu Jawatan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' a'aalh kɨklhi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ux gu oidha' gu vaak; gio ba' gu jodai' biipibop ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh i'iich gu chuukug cham gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tɨɨgim na ja'p gu tanoolh jix duñia' choo'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tanoolh i'iich gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu takarui' tu' juruuñdhai gu ñi'ook; na gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tu' buupui gu jodai' gu ux gu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tukgam gu' cham gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu chuukug zel; gio ba' jix duñia' o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tukgam na ja'p tu' koko'kam jix jai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n cham gu takarui' jix buus; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook tu' jiiñak jix kup maatɨt soi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu jodai gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug jix duñia' ka't na ba' tu' na ja'p maavɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix dhaas na ja'p jix toja gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu baakɨi gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' taatam bɨɨx gu chuukug jix bhaan dhaas maatai.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu jodai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk nɨɨra gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt chɨ'ñchoka' gu i'ii'ñ na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' gu ux xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios cham gu'ch gu jodai' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu jodai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix vɨɨk gu xibh; gio ba' jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' dɨr jix duñia'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu duukam jix duñia' na gu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chin oo' gu ux tu' gu kutun cham tu'x jai'ch nɨɨra.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan cham jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' va'k tu' gu ñi'ook gio gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt bɨx gu jodai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chio'ñ kuiñcha gu Jawatan cham gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr gu takarui' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan cham jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' cham bhai' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu chio'ñ na jix do'ig gu chio'ñ uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' kutun kavɨk gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Lebantemos gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n daak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt cham gu takarui'.
Na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n toov na gu' cham gu ñi'ook soi'm gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bhaan no'ch gu chin.
Jano' ba' choo'n jix duñia' ka't na ba' no'ch gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' mi'x juu'ñ gu vupui gu ux gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu vupui gu chuukug cham gu jodai' na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu chuukug dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu vupui jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ kiicham.
Jano' ba' obhɨɨ'ñ jix maa gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'uvhig cham gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas gu jodai bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs bhaan mo'o; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix koi jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr kuupa' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu chuukug naak tu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan kuiñcha gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu chuukug bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu suudai' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix búup gu kutun bhaan tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ mu'ai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' i'iich gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhai'x jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook jix bhai' jix uam jodai tu' gu suudai' gu jodai xidhuu gu suudai' gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ux gu jodai' bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vaakax gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'uuv oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' nɨɨn gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu takarui' cham ka't gu takarui'.
Na jugi jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu gu vaak; na jix duu gu tasi' jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ gu Sodoma ka't bhaan gu suudai' cham jix duñia' bhaan jugi.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jabook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bii'm jugi gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jodai na jix tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug duñia'; gio ba' cham gu duukam gu ux gu vaak; mi' dhɨr zel gu jodai' o'oo jix gaki na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu koko'kam gu ñi'ook koko'kam bhiogi'; na gu' suulhgia' jix koko' gu jodai' gu ux uañi'ñ gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jugi gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu duukam ja'aa gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' gu tai gu Sioon jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' bɨx gu bhóogɨt oipichu' jɨɨ'ñ bhaamki'ñdha' gu tasi' ba'k gu ux kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ux uañi'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ux tu' na cham jir bhai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p ñiññia gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr cham gu takarui' kuichdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk jiboi'ññor jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' gui'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' daak gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu vupui jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu' chooto'n jugi kɨklhi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan chulhiiñdha' jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu kutun nɨɨra gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh; na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki jix dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook daak gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dua'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨkgiga'n gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr ka't kuupka' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug mar u'vɨ gu Edom jix daa gu oidha' gu us; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' sɨlhka'n gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Edom; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' chulhiiñdha' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu maa'nkar tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook oidha' maa'nkar gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu'ch cham gu taat naana'n na ja'p dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu suudai' gu ux tuumiñ; gio ba' gu kutun gu u'u gu ux u'uuk jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu kutun gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' no'ch jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkio gu Asirio gu jodai' gu novɨ na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' taata'n tattat jix duñia' koko'kam; gio ba' no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam jix duñia' no'ch; gio ba' cham ka't gu novɨ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu tasi' gu takarui' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu kutun zel jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu takarui' bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu Sioon gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' chiñia' jix duñia' gu ux gu novɨ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu vupui kɨklhi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' daraa jix duñia' ki'ñgob biipibop gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu bhóogɨt chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kuruun gu kutun mo'o; na gu' gu ñi'ook jano' no'ch na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' ka't gu takarui' chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux dhi' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu kutun.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' atooxkor gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ba' bɨɨx tas no'ch kiicha' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
